rules: Keep total video duration strictly between 40 and 48 seconds to balance platform pacing with our required enquiry arc.
Ensure both narrators maintain a sharp conversational cadence with no dead air between speaker handoffs.
Use real-world archival footage or clear 2D animated diagrams exclusively; never use photo-real AI generation.
Never include calls to action like subscribing or liking, allowing the natural loop ending to drive retention.
Open every video with a bold, high-contrast on-screen hook title in the first 3 seconds.
Formulate every script around an accurate, surprising physical or biological mechanism rather than generic trivia.
